question.knowledge_point: Computing the Mean of a Data Set
question.problem:
A college basketball player scored the following number of points in the last five games he played:

$$
9,\,11,\,12,\,8,\,10
$$

What is the mean of these scores?
question.worked_solution:
If we have a data set that consists of the points ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n},$ then the mean is denoted by $\overset{―}{x}$ and is given by the following formula:

$$
\overset{―}{x}=\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}
$$

Here, there are $n=5$ data points. Adding up all the points in the data set, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{5}{x}_{i} & =9+11+12+8+10 \\  & =50.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the mean is

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\frac{1}{n}{\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i} \\  & =\frac{1}{5}\cdot 50 \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
